What you can use OGTV for

A TV that's always on

Free live-style TV in Hindi and English: 47 channels that are always playing, like cable TV, with no sign-up and no subscription. Open it and something is already on: Latest Mix, the last two days' trending videos from every channel, Sports first. Flip channels with a swipe, the arrow keys or the retro TV's Channel knob, or go full screen. It works on phones, laptops and a smart TV's browser.

Latest Mix · Aangan · Classics · Retro Movies · South Gems · Comedy · Fiction

A radio

Radio mode (the Radio button, or A) plays the sound of any channel while the screen shows what's on and what's next; the picture stays in a small window, as YouTube asks. Use it in the kitchen, in the car over Bluetooth, or while you work. On Android, the Brave browser keeps it playing with the phone's screen off, and the headphone or lock-screen buttons change channel.

An iPod for Indian music

A music player with nothing to set up: every music channel is a non-stop playlist by era, artist or style, so you choose a channel instead of choosing songs. Select for favourites, Bollywood by decade from the 60s to the 2010s, this week's trending songs, Punjabi, South Indian, the world's top hits, classical and devotional music. The next and previous buttons on headphones change channel.

Questions

What is OGTV?

OGTV is a free TV-style app for India: 47 always-on channels built from official YouTube uploads, from live news, cricket and the Olympics to Bollywood, bhajans, KBC, Taarak Mehta and documentaries, in Hindi and English. Open it and something is already playing.

Is OGTV free?

Yes. There is no sign-up and no subscription. Videos play from YouTube, so they work on any phone, laptop or smart TV with a browser.

Is OGTV a YouTube alternative?

It is a different way to watch YouTube. Instead of searching and scrolling, you flip through channels like on TV, and every channel runs to a schedule, so everyone tuned in sees the same moment.

What is Latest Mix on OGTV?

Latest Mix is OGTV's channel 1 and the one it opens on (https://ogtv.co.in/latest-mix/): the last two days' trending videos from every OGTV channel, ranked by how fast they are being watched and refreshed every hour. A video is always playing, the next one follows by itself, and a list of the mix over the picture lets you pick any; there is the same number of news, knowledge, sports, lifestyle, entertainment and music, and Sports starts with Indian cricket.

What's trending on YouTube in India today?

Latest Mix on OGTV (https://ogtv.co.in/latest-mix/) plays the last two days' trending videos from every OGTV channel, ranked by how fast they are being watched and updated every hour: the same number of news, knowledge, sports, lifestyle, entertainment and music, Indian cricket first in sports. OGTV opens on it.

How is OGTV different from OTT apps like Netflix, Hotstar or JioCinema?

OTT apps ask you to pick from a library and usually charge a subscription. OGTV is free live-style TV: channels that are always on, like cable TV, with no account and nothing to choose before watching.

Is there an OGTV app for phone or TV?

Yes. Open ogtv.co.in and choose Install app (or Add to Home screen) in your browser. It then opens full screen like an app on Android, iPhone, laptops and smart TVs.

Which channels does OGTV have?

Latest, News, Knowledge, Sports, Lifestyle, Entertainment, Music: Latest Mix, Just News, Khabar, Magadh Times, Newsroom, Gyaan, Discover, Curious, India in Data, Classroom, Digital System Design, Tech, Paisa, Baatcheet, Niche, Cricket, Khel, Cricket Classics, Football, International Sports, Sehat, Rasoi, Safar, Bachche, Aangan, Comedy, Purvaiya, Fiction, Retro Movies, Classics, South Gems, Select, Desi Pop, Drive, Vibe, 2010s Hits, 2000s Hits, 90s Hits, Deccan Chargers, Anthems, Global Hits, Gym, Punjabi, Raag, Sadabahar, Bhakti, Sargam.

Is there a free TV, radio and news app for India?

Yes: OGTV (ogtv.co.in). It is free TV for India (https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-tv/), a radio with its Radio mode (https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-radio/) and live and Hindi news (https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-news/), in one app with no sign-up.

Is there free sports streaming for India on OGTV?

OGTV has free sports channels with today's cricket highlights, this week's football, the Olympics and world sport, from official uploads (https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-sports/). It doesn't show live matches.

What is a good daily feed for India without scrolling?

OGTV plays the day's news, cricket highlights, trending songs and markets as always-on channels, so there is nothing to scroll (https://ogtv.co.in/for/daily-feed/).

Where can I find free music for India, from Bollywood to bhajans?

On OGTV's music channels, each a non-stop playlist: Select, Sadabahar, 90s Hits, 2000s Hits, 2010s Hits, Desi Pop, Punjabi, Deccan Chargers, Raag, Bhakti and more (https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-music/).

Can I use OGTV as a radio?

Yes. Radio mode (the Radio button, or the A key) plays the sound of any channel, with the screen showing what's playing and what's next, and the picture in a small window. Music channels such as Select, Sadabahar, 90s Hits and Desi Pop make a free radio for Hindi songs. On Android, the Brave browser keeps it playing with the phone's screen off.

Can OGTV be my music player, like an iPod?

Yes. Each music channel is a non-stop playlist, so you choose a channel instead of songs: Select, Sadabahar, 90s Hits, 2000s Hits, 2010s Hits, Desi Pop, Punjabi, Deccan Chargers, Global Hits and Anthems. Headphone and lock-screen buttons change channel.

Which OGTV channel plays songs for my mood?

Select for favourites, Drive for a road trip, Gym for a workout, Vibe for a party or a festival, Raag for calm and focus, Sadabahar for old-time nostalgia, 90s Hits for romance, Bhakti for prayer and Anthems for singing along.

Where can I watch today's cricket highlights for free?

On OGTV's Cricket channel: highlights from every major match of the day, India and the IPL first, from the official broadcasters' YouTube uploads. Cricket Classics plays World Cup classics and great finishes.

Can I watch live news on OGTV?

Yes. Just News plays live news around the clock, Khabar has Hindi news and analysis, Magadh Times covers Bihar and Jharkhand, and Newsroom has world affairs from Palki Sharma's Vantage, WION, Firstpost, Mint and Bloomberg.

Can I watch a programme from the beginning?

Yes. From start (or the B key) plays the programme on now from its first minute; when it ends, the channel is live again. Press it again to go back live sooner.

About

GTV

YouTube, the way TV used to be

OGTV turns Indian YouTube into 47 always-on channels, from cricket, Olympic sport and F1 to Bhakti, festivals, Doordarshan classics, Bollywood and science. No searching, no feeds: switch on, flip channels, watch what's on.

Everyone sees the same moment

Each channel runs on a schedule built from time-of-day rules, so every viewer tuned to a channel is at the same point of the same programme, like real TV. New uploads from 670+ creators, channels and playlists are added every night, and live channels pick up official streams as they go on air.

By Shubhank Sargam · Privacy · Terms

Getting started

OGTV is free TV made from YouTube: channels that are always on, from news and cricket to bhajans, films and music, in Hindi and English. There is nothing to sign up for. It opens on Latest Mix, the last two days' trending videos.

  • Tap Press to start once, so your browser lets the sound play.
  • Every channel runs to a schedule, so everyone watching sees the same moment, like real TV. You will often join a programme part-way through; that is normal, and From start plays it from its beginning.
  • Between programmes a Coming up next card shows what starts next.
  • Under the TV: the programme's title and times, a bar showing how far in it is, On air because (the time slot and topic that put it on air) and what's next.

Latest Mix

Latest Mix is channel 1, where OGTV opens: the last two days' trending videos from every OGTV channel, ranked by how fast they are being watched and refreshed every hour. A video is always playing, and the next one follows by itself.

  • What's in it: the same number of videos from News, Knowledge, Sports, Lifestyle, Entertainment and Music. It starts with Sports, Indian cricket first.
  • The list of the mix: titles only, category by category, with the video playing marked. It comes up when you tune in, move the mouse over the picture or tap it, and goes after a few seconds.
  • Pick a video: click or tap its title. On a phone, swipe along the list to see more.
  • The mix (where From start usually is), or B: keeps the list up; press it again to put the list away.
  • Keyboard or TV remote: Enter (OK) opens the list at the video playing, ← → move along it, ↑ ↓ jump to the next category, Enter plays, Esc (Back) closes it. With the list closed, ← → change channel as usual.
  • A video that won't play in your browser is replaced by another from the same category, so every category keeps the same number.

Watch from the beginning

Joined a programme part-way through? From start plays it again from its first minute.

  • On the page: the From start button at the top, or the same button on the picture, beside Full screen.
  • Full screen: the From start button with the others at the bottom (move the mouse or tap to bring them up).
  • Retro TV: the From start key under the knobs.
  • Programme guide: From start under any channel's programme on now. It switches to that channel and starts the programme from the beginning.
  • Keyboard: B.

The programme plays to its end, and then the channel is live again, with whatever is on at that moment. While it plays, the button turns orange with a live sign, and the panel under the TV says From the start and what you'll join afterwards.

  • Back to live any time: press the same button again (it says Go live), or B. Changing channel also takes you back to live.
  • Pause holds your place: play carries on from where you stopped.
  • Live broadcasts (marked LIVE) always play at the live moment, so they can't be started over; the button rests, dimmed.

Changing channel

  • Phone or tablet: swipe sideways across the picture, left for the next channel and right for the one before. On the retro TV the set shows the channel it lands on.
  • Programme guide: tap Watch or a channel's name.
  • Keyboard: → for the next channel, ← for the one before, or type its number (two digits for 10 and up: 1 2 is channel 12).
  • Retro TV: turn the Channel knob.
  • Headphones, car or lock screen: the next and previous track buttons change channel.
  • Share a channel: the address in your browser always points to the channel you're watching. Copy it and send it.

Programme guide

Below the TV is every channel, in groups: News, Knowledge, Sports, Lifestyle, Entertainment and Music. Press C to jump there.

  • Each card shows what's on, the YouTube channel it comes from, its description (tap More to read it all), how long is left, and what's next.
  • Tap an hour (13:00, 21:00…) to see what every channel plays then. Now brings you back.
  • Rest of today opens a channel's whole day, programme by programme.
  • From start under a programme on now plays it from its beginning (see Watch from the beginning).
  • NEW marks videos uploaded in the last 30 days; LIVE marks a live stream.
  • The channel you're watching is outlined in orange, and its button says Watching.
  • All times are India Standard Time. Later programmes can change a little when new videos arrive overnight.

Sound and pause

  • Sound: if the picture plays silently, tap Turn sound on. M turns the sound off and on, and ↑ ↓ set the volume. On the retro TV, use the Volume knob (click it to mute) or the Mute key. Opened from an app such as X, Instagram or WhatsApp? Its built-in browser wants a tap on the picture itself: when Tap the picture for sound shows, tap the picture once.
  • Pause: tap or click the picture (in full screen too), press K or Space, or use the pause button in full screen.
  • Listening with the phone's screen off: most browsers pause YouTube when the screen goes dark. On Android, open OGTV in the Brave browser: it keeps playing with the screen off, and the lock screen's buttons pause it and change channel. Radio (A) suits this best.

Full screen

  • Tap Home, Maximize for the best experience or the full-screen button on the picture, or press F.
  • The channel's name appears as you change channel, and the buttons fade when you leave them alone.
  • To see every channel in a strip, move the mouse to the bottom. Click a channel to watch it, or move along the strip with ← → and press Enter. On a phone or tablet, swipe sideways to change channel and up or down to set the volume.
  • On iPhone, OGTV fills the browser window. For true full screen, add it to your Home Screen (see Install as an app).
  • Esc leaves full screen.

Retro

OGTV opens in an old wooden TV set. Retro (or R) switches it off and on.

  • Channel knob: drag it round, scroll over it, or click just to one side of its pointer to move one channel.
  • Radio: the sound of whatever is on, with the screen showing the channel, the song or programme and what's next. The picture keeps playing in a small window, as YouTube asks. Use Radio at the top, in full screen, or A; on the retro TV it is a setting of the Mode knob. To listen with your phone's screen off, see Sound and pause.
  • Mode knob: how old the picture looks. Full: every tape effect. Steady: no rolling band. Tinted (where it starts): tape colours only. Clean: a clear picture. Quiet: no static hiss between channels either. Radio: the sound, with a small picture (see Radio below). Normal: retro off. Click it for the next setting.
  • Volume knob: turn it to set the volume; click it to mute or unmute.
  • The keys beside the knobs are Mute, From start and Full screen.

Install as an app

  • Android: in Chrome's menu (⋮), choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
  • iPhone and iPad: in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
  • Other browsers: look for Install app or Add to Home screen in the browser's menu.
  • OGTV then opens full screen, like any other app.

If something goes wrong

  • A video that won't play is skipped, and the channel moves on by itself.
  • No sound? Tap Turn sound on, or press M. If Tap the picture for sound shows, tap the picture.
  • Picture stuck? Reload the page. You rejoin each channel where it is now.
  • OGTV picks up new videos every night. An open page updates itself quietly between programmes once you haven't touched it for a while.
